about: Hand-labelled test set, written before any results were seen. Only stable, well-known facts. 'search_query' is written by hand (the extract step is tested separately in the end-to-end answers).
review_notes_written_after_the_first_run: The first live run used 19 live AI calls. The second run used 1 more: a Wikipedia search that had failed in run 1 now worked, so the reflect step had new evidence to judge (same scores). Later runs are served from the cache (0 calls).

The 1 end-to-end 'false alarm' (Great Pyramid tallest 'for more than 3,800 years') is really a labelling mistake by the author: current Wikipedia says 'more than 3,700 years', and the judge followed its evidence. The score is left as computed, not edited. It is a good example of numbers that differ between sources.

The missed false claim ('Amazon flows mainly through Argentina') came back Not enough evidence: the Wikipedia intro names Peru and Brazil but never says 'not Argentina'. The judge is told that missing information is not a contradiction, so it is cautious here.
The missed planted error (Venus day length) came back Not enough evidence because the Wikipedia intro does not mention day length.
One Wikipedia request (from the reflect step) still failed after 2 retries because Wikipedia was rate-limiting; that claim kept its first-round verdict.

answers.text: The Great Pyramid of Giza is in Egypt. It was built as a tomb for the pharaoh Khufu. It was the tallest man-made structure in the world for more than 3,800 years.
Alexander Graham Bell is credited with inventing the telephone. He was born in Edinburgh, Scotland, in 1847. He later founded the software company Microsoft.
The Titanic sank in 1912 after hitting an iceberg on its maiden voyage from Southampton to New York City. It was operated by the Cunard Line.
Penicillin was discovered by Louis Pasteur in 1928. Penicillins are used to treat bacterial infections.
Venus is the second planet from the Sun. It is the hottest planet in the Solar System. A day on Venus is shorter than a day on Earth.
